name: robots/isaaczh__himloco_lab
title: HimLoco Unitree Go2 velocity (Isaac Lab simulation)
intro: HimLoco Unitree Go2 velocity (Isaac Lab simulation), adapted from isaaczh/himloco_lab. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
